Definition: from G3022; to whiten:--make white, whiten.
BiblicalUsage: leukaínō means make white, whiten, and the verse where it stands does the talking. In Mark 9:3, "so as no fuller on earth can white them."; and in Revelation 7:14, "and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe whiteness is God's work — no fuller on earth can white a garment like the blood of the Lamb.
